purpose: A three-way junction (Prism Run west, Glass Gallery east, Shard Vault below) whose only real content is dropping through the one-way slot in the floor.

recommendation: Give the junction a stake: put a coin up among the currently-unused upper one-way platforms under the vvvvv spikes, so the room offers an optional spike-ceiling jump puzzle instead of dead decoration.

purpose: A three-way junction early in the run (floor key 2) that routes the player west/east/down, with the mandatory path being a drop through one-way platforms into the floor gap to Root Cellar.

purpose: A wall-jump/one-way-platform ascent up two split pillars that serves as the vertical connector to Rafter Shrine while also linking the west-east horizontal corridor.

recommendation: Keep the climb, but widen the tightest wall-jump window (the DropRepeatFrame 9/64 chokepoint, likely the staggered one-way ledges between the two pillars) so retrying feels fair rather than frame-perfect; alternatively add a coin atop the spire so the demanding branch pays off.

purpose: An execution-test room: a spike-lined wall-jump chute followed by a one-way-platform ladder guarding coin 52 on the mandatory west-to-east path.

purpose: Optional-feeling coin cache: a short dash-assisted climb up staggered one-way platforms to collect coin 26.

purpose: A three-way junction whose ceiling route is a zig-zag one-way-platform climb guarding access to Storm Cache.

purpose: A short dash-over-spikes execution corridor guarding coin 45 on the Mirror Fork to Furnace Lift link.

purpose: A wall-jump execution test: an optional-feeling but coin-gated climb up a narrow chimney whose walls carry staggered spikes, guarding dungeon-coin-19 on the west-to-east corridor.

purpose: Nominally a connective corridor between Climber's Gate and Three-Way Hall with one optional coin on high one-way platforms, but the mandatory path serves no function beyond distance.

purpose: A three-way junction routing traffic between Vacuum Gallery (west), Aurora Spire (east), and the floor drop into Lunar Cache.

purpose: A dead-end treasure vault: an optional side room off Rootbound Underpass whose job is to make players earn two coins by climbing a spike-floored one-way-platform ascent.

purpose: A three-way junction (west/east/ceiling) with a free coin, functioning as a low-stakes connective corridor between two coin-gated doors.

purpose: A coin-guarding execution challenge: a spike-lined wall-jump chute followed by a one-way-platform zigzag climb, testing mixed wall-jump/dash movement on the Meteor Run -> Tidal Fork path.

purpose: A dash-ladder coin challenge: an open shaft of staggered one-way platforms you climb (mostly by dashing) above a walk-through bottom corridor to grab coin 29, with a spike pair punishing sloppy drops.
